about: How the insides of Vallarith's rolled hex sites are laid out the first time they are entered (dungeon/delving.py generated): per site kind, how many rooms, on which levels, and what the rooms, passages, foes, hazards and loot are drawn from. Entries with `intensity` only come up at those levels or higher, as site entries do.

entrance.name: The broken doorway
entrance.summary: A doorway with no door, the lintel cracked across. Weeds grow up through the threshold.

rooms_table.name: the roofless hall
rooms_table.summary: A long hall open to the sky, the hearth at one end full of old leaves.

rooms_table.name: the tower stump
rooms_table.summary: The base of a tower, its stair climbing a few turns and stopping in the air.

rooms_table.name: the chapel
rooms_table.summary: A small chapel, the altar stone split and the god's face chiselled off it.

rooms_table.name: the kitchens
rooms_table.summary: Kitchens with a collapsed bread oven and a well covered by a rotten lid.

rooms_table.name: the wine cellar
rooms_table.summary: Racks of broken bottles and a sour smell that never left.

rooms_table.name: the cells
rooms_table.summary: Three cells with their doors hanging open, chains still bolted to the walls.

rooms_table.name: the old vault
rooms_table.summary: A vault older than the house above it, the stones cut in a way nobody cuts them any more.
features: a niche with something in it

down.summary: steps going down into the dark

hazards.action: cross the rotten floor without going through it
hazards.threat: The boards give way and the character drops into the dark below, landing hard among the rubble.

hazards.action: get past without bringing the wall down
hazards.threat: Stones come down from the wall top in a slide of dust and mortar.

wanders.text: Something moves in the rubble, a fox or a rat, and is gone.
The wind finds a gap in the walls and moans through it.

wanders.action: hear the others who use the ruin before they come in

threat.text: Outlaws come in by another way, and stop dead at the sight of the character.

entrance.name: The cave mouth
entrance.summary: The mouth of the cave, cold air breathing out of it, old soot on the roof.

rooms_table.name: the dripping gallery
rooms_table.summary: A long gallery where water drips from a hundred points into shallow pools.

rooms_table.name: the bone pocket
rooms_table.summary: A low pocket off the passage, the floor deep in small bones.

rooms_table.name: the painted chamber
rooms_table.summary: A chamber whose walls are covered in old red handprints and running animals.
features: running animals painted on the rock

rooms_table.name: the black pool
rooms_table.summary: A wide chamber taken up by still black water. It is impossible to tell how deep it is.
features: an echo that comes back wrong

rooms_table.name: the narrows
rooms_table.summary: The rock closes in until it is a squeeze to go on.
features: scratches on the rock at shoulder height

down.summary: a drop down a chimney in the rock

hazards.action: climb the wet rock without slipping
hazards.threat: A foot goes out on the wet rock and the character falls, hard, against the stone.

hazards.action: keep their nerve in the squeeze
hazards.threat: Wedged in the rock in the dark, panic takes hold, and it is a long time before they can move again.

wanders.text: Water drips somewhere, slow as a clock.
Bats pour past overhead in a rush of leather and are gone.

wanders.action: keep the light burning in the draught
wanders.threat: A cold breath of air puts the light out, and the dark is total.

entrance.name: The way into the lair
entrance.summary: A trampled way in between rocks, bones cracked for marrow scattered across it.

rooms_table.name: the den
rooms_table.summary: The den itself: a hollow of flattened bedding and a stink that sticks to clothes.

rooms_table.name: the larder
rooms_table.summary: Where the beast keeps what it has not eaten yet.

rooms_table.name: the back hollow
rooms_table.summary: A hollow behind the den, quieter, where the young are kept.
features: a nest of hair and grass

wanders.text: A low growl from somewhere deeper in, and then quiet.

wanders.action: be gone before the beast comes back to its lair

threat.text: The lair's owner comes back, and finds the character in its home.

entrance.name: The barrow door
entrance.summary: The stone door of a barrow, pushed half open some time ago by someone who wanted in.

rooms_table.name: the burial passage
rooms_table.summary: A low stone passage lined with niches, each with its sleeper.
features: niches with the dead in them

rooms_table.name: the captain's chamber
rooms_table.summary: A round chamber where a war captain lies on a stone bier in rusted mail.

rooms_table.name: the ossuary
rooms_table.summary: Bones stacked to the roof in patterns, skulls in rows facing the door.

hazards.action: go in without disturbing the dead
hazards.threat: A niche gives way and its sleeper spills out across the floor, and with it the sense of being watched.

wanders.text: Somewhere in the barrow a bone settles with a small dry click.
The light gutters, though there is no draught.
